messages:
sam: Morning — quick async stand for the release wave. What I did / blockers / today.

sam: Done: backfilled canary traffic routing for model-proxy, cut cherry-pick PR #821 for the latency outlier fix. Verified basic perf locally.

sam: Blocker: one of the Buildkite release jobs is flaking on the windows-image step; it stalls and holds the train. I think we should bypass that job for the patch cut to avoid blocking the whole rollout.

rui: Quick Q — is PR #821 safe to land on 2.3.x branch? Any chance it touches kv-cache semantics?

maria: I reviewed #821 earlier. It only changes batching heuristics and a tiny codepath in rate-limiter. Ran it against the kv-cache unit tests — all green. Pushed hotfix branch `hot/2.3.1/cherry-821`. :white_check_mark:

maria: I also added an extra regression test to cover the scenario that caused the original spike.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: canary -> prod at 2025-08-12T11:30Z triggered by <@sam>. Canary target: 5% traffic for 30m.

eva: For the flaky job, try `BUILDKITE_AGENT_META_DATA=cachefalse ./scripts/ci/run.sh` — that cleared it once before. If it still flakes, we can re-route to dedicated runners.

sam: Good call, eva. I'll kick a manual run with that env and if it keeps failing I'll mark the job non-blocking for this wave.

dan: Heads-up — docs PR that describes the new rollout behavior needs one last review. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/454. Pinging @maria for final sign-off.

maria: On docs PR, ETA 45m. Will do a final pass and merge if no issues.

rui: Canary plan: if 5% stays stable for 30m, bump to 50% with 10m observation, then full. Do we want an automatic rollback threshold?

sam: Yes — rollback if 99th p90 token latency increases >20% or if error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m. I'll attach the monitor links when canary starts.

maria: I also prepared a rollback branch `hot/2.3.1/rollback` that reverts the batching heuristic in case we need a quick revert.

eva: FYI there's a flaky integration test in nightly that can show up after the rollout. I put a note in the test ticket with steps to reproduce.

sam: Plan for today: finish the manual Buildkite retry, start the 5% canary at the scheduled time, monitor latency + errors, hold full rollout until 30m stable and green on tests. I'll post status updates here.

dan: I'll watch the docs merge and update release notes once PR is merged.

rui: If anyone needs me during the canary window ping me directly — I'll be on pager.

sam: thanks team. Will update in ~15m after the manual run. :eyes:
